coverageSpotVerification.detail: Grader ran each suite from the clean grading checkout against its own backend: m1-m6 and m8 passed with no missing coverage, matching coverage-manifest.json. The 19 sampled mappings were read in scripts/acceptance*.mjs, and each mapped test exercises its assertion's observable. Several UI-flavored assertions are covered at the API level rather than through the UI: m2-a01..a03 create posts via API, m2-a16 checks the repost actor field rather than the 'Reposted by' label, m4-a06/a07 use set-state intents directly, and m8-a06 inserts a backdated post through the dev /seed route. That is weaker, but not dishonest. The grader independently verified those UI paths (compose, attribution label, reaction tap-to-clear) and all passed.

defects.summary: A group-membership action (remove or promote) tapped in chat settings is silently lost if the page navigates or reloads before local admission (~50 ms). The roster change shows in the UI, but the server keeps the member as recipient, so a 'removed' member keeps receiving new messages. Server authorization is correct once the mutation arrives; human-paced use (1.5 s settle) was 4/4 correct.
defects.evidence: trace.md#5c-removal-reproduction (evidence/web-removal-race-results.json: 4/6 lost; web-removal-settled-results.json: 0/4 lost); trace.md#8 (frozen harness 'removed member received a new live group message' in grader run 1 and clean rerun 4; builder had one earlier failure); source src/chat.tsx ChatSettings action()

defects.summary: The profile Follow/Following toggle sends set: !countsData.followed from a possibly stale counts query. Revisiting a profile within about a second of a change shows the old state, and the tap re-applies the current state (no-op) instead of toggling. The frozen harness check repost-following-feed-surface failed 2 of 3 attempts in both builder and grader runs for this reason.

O1.anchorsCited: Interpolated between ~60 ('M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap') and ~90 ('every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts').
O1.justification: 99 of 119 in-scope assertions pass under independent execution (M1-M7 subset: 83 of 101; M8: 16 of 18). M1, M2, M4 and M5 pass completely. M3 fails m3-a02 (no sender avatars in DMs) and m3-a12 (frozen harness shows a removed member still receiving messages, 2/2 clean grader runs). M6 and M8 web behavior is solid, but all 9 native-artifact assertions (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17/a18) are not-run. M7 (9 assertions) was never attempted, and the frozen denominator counts it as not-passed. Every attempted milestone reached web green and Hermes bundles verify, but the missing platform-proof artifacts and M7 keep the score below the 90 anchor. Evidence: trace.md#2, #4-#9.

O2.anchorsCited: Interpolated between ~60 ('a few medium defects off the happy path') and ~90 ('only cosmetic nits'); well above ~30 ('multiple high-severity defects in core flows').
O2.justification: No blocker or major defects. Six minor defects: d-01 membership action lost on navigation within ~50 ms; d-02 stale follow-toggle intent; d-03 non-atomic signup on duplicate handle; d-04 thin typing-expiry margin; d-05 HTTP global search never complete; d-06 steep cold web sync growth. Two cosmetic: d-07 'Direct message' titles; d-08 binary unread badge. All minors are off the happy path or timing edges. Server-side data integrity, windows, revocation, digest and push checks were all correct. Evidence: trace.md#11 and defects[].

O3.anchorsCited: Just below ~90 ('every probe correctly denied, including asset access after view-once/delete'); well above ~60 ('core reads protected; a secondary probe (e.g., expired-window edit) succeeds when it shouldn't').
O3.justification: PROVISIONAL (deviation 1): no rotated holdout set was committed, so no scored probes exist. This placement comes from grader-authored checks covering all seven published trust-boundary categories, and is not a holdout score. Cross-user DM history, search, send and conversation reads were denied or empty. A removed member was cut off server-side (history 0 rows, send NOT_MEMBER). View-once assets gave 200 then 410 per member (outsider 404, anonymous 401), and re-attaching a consumed or foreign asset was refused (E_ASSET_UNKNOWN). Deleted media returned 404 for all principals. Expired edit and delete windows were refused server-side, and caller-supplied at/now returned E_INPUT. Tokens were revoked on logout and refresh. Offline cache never rendered expired content, even offline before sync. Digest counts excluded non-member, removed-member, tombstoned and read activity. Service routes were refused to user tokens. Held just below 90 because the probes are not the hidden set, and because d-01 lets a UI removal silently fail to reach the server (the server-side rule itself holds). Evidence: trace.md#4, #6, #7, #5c.

O4.anchorsCited: Just below ~30 ('cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app'); ~60 ('reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush') and ~90 ('...all behave as specced on the native proof — on full runs including M8's durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence') both require native-proof evidence that does not exist.
O4.justification: Applicable (M6 green), but no iOS-simulator choreography artifact was recorded for M6 or M8 (supplementalExternal ios-simulator-m6/m8 status not-recorded, pass null). So no native cold-start read, media, search, view-once exclusion, ordered queue flush, receipt walk or durable restart was demonstrated, and missing evidence cannot pass. The gap was disclosed honestly rather than claimed. Harness web receipts (M6 offline queue flush in order; M8 dual-offline convergence, receipts and cross-device read state), plus the grader's own offline relaunch and search observations, show the web offline path works. That is supplementary and cannot substitute for the native proof. Evidence: trace.md#9, #8, #6.

O5.bandRationale: First-match order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75. Branch 0 did not fire. The final state conforms to invariant-manifest-combined.json: the lane verified at 10%, 50% and final, and the grader re-queried a clone of scale-instance (1008 profiles, 5921 follows, 50228 posts, 100015 messages, 5008 likes, 2000 reactions, 1002 conversations). Named fixtures match exactly: u0500 follows 500 and is in 100 conversations; u0005 follows 5; u0900 has 900 followers and 200 posts; u0901 follows u0001-u0004 and u0900; g0001 has 50 members and 10000 messages. The replay cap is an uncalibrated placeholder and the replay completed in 1149 s, so cap exhaustion is not shown. Branch 30 fired: the global message-search probe errored at every checkpoint (HTTP query returned complete:false with zero rows; lane performance-summary globalSearchCurveValid:false). No valid three-size search curve exists, so perf-search-scaling cannot pass, and an erroring probe trips perf-envelope-stability. The other lane-measured rules passed: page50/page1 1.21; following 500/5 1.88; celebrity write 0.78; celebrity-follower read 1.18; insights full/10% 0.83 and trending 1.02 with midpoints below the line; busy-group send p95 6.8 ms; cold sync completed. Caveat: no rotated probe set or hidden sample seed was committed, so the inputs are the lane's own diagnostic probes, and absolute ceilings are uncalibrated.
